name: perf-rig
description: Frame-timing capture and scoring for web apps on real devices, with input and measurement on separate channels.

x-notes.peer: playwright-core must resolve to the same version as the consuming app's @playwright/test, or a second browser set downloads; the consumer adds a version drift guard.
x-notes.no-appium-client: The WebDriver client is hand-rolled over fetch; the package never depends on appium or webdriverio.
x-notes.host-tools: adb, xcrun, idevice_id, iproxy, pymobiledevice3, an Appium server, perfetto and xctrace are discovered by doctor, never installed.
x-notes.install-scripts: None. A registry tarball is inert under pnpm's fail-closed allowBuilds; a link: install at the nested rung is registered explicitly by the consumer.
